items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: they had this room, this back room there, where there was a session every night. You'd go in there and there would be guys like Chu Berry and Johnny Russell and, oh, Frank Newton

ctx.x: Did Charley Johnson's band -- I'm not -- I don't know about it, so, did it have interesting soloists also?

Well, they -- let's put it this way, it was a swinging band for that era. They had a drummer, I can't remember his last name, his name was George something, he was just excellent. And let's see, I don't know if they were in the band at that time, but at one time the trumpet players were Bill Coleman and Frank Newton. And it was, oh, I guess they had -- well, it was just like two trumpets and a trombone and three saxophones and four rhythm. It wasn't, you know, one of those huge bands. But none of the bands were…
